case_title: JOSE O'COIRBHIN et al VS. KATHLEEN OLIVER et al

docket_entries.description: REPLY TO OPPOSIITON TO MOTION TO ENFORCE SETTLEMENT; DECL. OF MARY CATHERINE WIEDERHOLD FILED BY DEFENDANT OLIVER, KATHLEEN
MINI-MINUTES FOR JUL-23-2010 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301
ORDER REGARDING DEFENDANT KATHLEEN OLIVER'S MOTION FOR A NEW TRIAL, OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT KATHLEEN OLIVER'S MOTION TO ENFORCE SETTLEMENT PURSUANT TO TERMS OF SETTLEMENT (CCP 664.6) AGAINST PLAINTIFFS JOSE O'COIRBHIN AND JENNIFER LEEPER IS GRANTED. ALTHOUGH THERE IS AMBIGUITY IN LIGHT OF THE "FULL COMPLIANCE " LANGUAGE IN PARAGRAPH 4, IT IS CLEAR FROM PARAGRAPHS 3, 4 AND 12 THAT THE PARTIES DID NOT CONTEMPLATE THAT EVERY FAILURE TO COMPLY NECESSARILY FORFEITED THE ENTIRE $12,000 AND NONE OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES AGREED TO REDUCE THAT AMOUNT OCCURED IN THIS CASE. REQUEST FOR SANCTION IS DENIED BY THE COURT. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT KATHLEEN OLIVER'S MOTION FOR A NEW TRIAL OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, DEFENDANT'S MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION IS GRANTED FOR THE LIMITED PURPOSE OF CLARIFYING THAT THE EARLIER ORDER AND JUDGMENT WERE INTENDED ONLY TO ENTER JUDGMENT ON THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT ACCORDING TO ITS TERMS, INCLUDING PLAINTIFF'S RIGHT TO IMMEDIATE POSSESSION AND WERE NOT INTENDED TO DETERMINE WHETHER DEFENDANT WAS ENTITLED TO ANY OR ALL PART OF THE $ 12,000 PAYMENT GIVEN THE FACTS JUSTIFYING IMMEDIATE POSSESSION EXCEPT AS THE ORDER AND JUDGMENT ARE SO CLARIFIED, THE MOTION IS DENIED. MS. WIEDERHOLD TO PREPARE FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189 301/PJB
